newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups Glaxo growth.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman ups Glaxo growth.

text.p: Analysts at Lehman Brothers said on Wednesday they had raised their estimate for underlying earnings growth at Glaxo Wellcome Plc, following the drug company's upbeat statement at its annual shareholders' meeting on Monday.

Lehman upped its estimate for annual earnings growth through the next five years to 11 percent from nine percent, but kept its recommendation at "neutral" since heavy marketing costs were expected to hold down margins.
At its AGM on May 19, Glaxo said it expected to return to double-digit sales growth by 1999 as newer drugs fill the gap left by Zantac as its patent expires in the United States.
